name: Freelancer Finance Bundle
tagline: Both spreadsheets: track your business money and your recurring costs.
description: The Freelancer Money Tracker and the Subscription Auditor together, for less than buying them separately.
Use the tracker to see what your business earns and what to set aside, then use the auditor to trim the recurring costs that eat into it.
features: Freelancer Money Tracker: invoices, expenses, monthly summary and tax set-aside
Subscription Auditor: recurring costs, renewal flags and potential savings
Costs less than buying both separately
contents: Freelancer Money Tracker (example and blank .xlsx files)

faq.q: Is anything different from buying them separately?
faq.a: No. The files are identical to the individual products. The bundle is just cheaper.

faq.q: Which apps does it work in?
faq.a: Both files are standard .xlsx files that Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice and Apple Numbers support.
